Attack: Quest XP, tada Slayer su tinkamu melee weapon.
Quest XP, then Slayer with a suitable melee weapon.
Strength: Quest XP ir Slayer; AFK combat pasirinkimas tik pagal savo supplies.
Quest XP and Slayer; choose AFK combat using your supplies.
Defence: Quest XP ir combat training pagal kitą gear requirement.
Quest XP and combat training toward the next gear requirement.
Hitpoints: Combat training kartu su pasirinktu Slayer ar combat tikslu.
Combat training alongside the chosen Slayer or combat goal.
Ranged: Quest XP, tada tinkamas bow/crossbow ir ammunition pagal account type.
Quest XP, then a suitable bow/crossbow and ammunition for the account type.
Magic: Quest XP ir combat spells; alchemy tik su spell level, runes ir tinkamais daiktais.
Quest XP and combat spells; use alchemy only with the spell level, runes and suitable items.
Prayer: Quest XP ir turimi bones; saugų metodą rinkis pagal account type.
Quest XP and available bones; select a safe method for the account type.
Agility: Quest XP, tada prieinamas course; marks of grace tik rooftop kursuose.
Quest XP, then an accessible course; collect marks of grace on rooftop courses.
Herblore: Druidic Ritual, quest lamps ir potions iš turimų herbs bei secondaries.
Druidic Ritual, quest lamps and potions using available herbs and secondaries.
Thieving: Quest XP, prieinami stalls/pickpocket; rogue outfit prieš ilgą pickpocket etapą.
Quest XP, accessible stalls/pickpocketing; rogue equipment before extended pickpocketing.
Crafting: Quest XP, tada glass/gems pagal turimus resursus; seaweed ir sand kaupk iš anksto.
Quest XP, then glass/gems using available resources; collect seaweed and sand ahead of time.
Construction: Pradinis quest XP ir planks; Mahogany Homes arba POH pagal GP bei planks.
Starter quest XP and planks; Mahogany Homes or POH training depending on GP and planks.
Fishing: Quest XP, maisto tiekimas arba Barbarian Fishing kaip AFK šaka.
Quest XP, food supplies or Barbarian Fishing as an AFK branch.
Cooking: Quest XP, tada turimo maisto ruošimas; nereikia pirkti perteklinio kiekio.
Quest XP, then cooking available food; avoid buying excess supplies.
Firemaking: Logs pagal dabartinį level; Wintertodt pasirenkama šaka nuo 50 Firemaking.
Use logs appropriate to your level; Wintertodt is an optional branch from 50 Firemaking.
Woodcutting: Quest XP, tada prieinami trees su tinkamu axe; logs panaudok kitiems skillams.
Quest XP, then accessible trees with a suitable axe; reuse logs for other skills.
Mining: Quest XP, ore resursai arba AFK mining; sand rinkimas gali palaikyti Crafting.
Quest XP, ore supplies or AFK mining; sand collection can support Crafting.
Smithing: Quest XP, tada bars ir prieinami minigames pagal GP bei ore.
Quest XP, then bars and accessible minigames using available GP and ore.
Fletching: Turimi logs ir ammunition; pirmiausia rezervuok quest bei birdhouse logs.
Available logs and ammunition; reserve quest and birdhouse logs first.
Runecraft: Quest XP, tada prieinamas altar ar minigame po jo quest reikalavimų.
Quest XP, then an accessible altar or minigame after its quest requirements.
Slayer: Pasirink master pagal combat ir quest prieigą; supplies bei block list tikrink atskirai.
Choose a master using combat level and quest access; check supplies and the block list separately.
Farming: Quest XP, herb/tree runs ir prieinami contracts; naudok turimas seeds.
Quest XP, herb/tree runs and accessible contracts using available seeds.
Hunter: Museum quiz, birdhouses po Bone Voyage; active Hunter kaip atskira šaka.
Museum quiz, birdhouses after Bone Voyage; active Hunter is a separate branch.
Sailing: Sek dabartinį Sailing mokymą ir quest unlocks; senas Nooblet maršrutas šio skill neapima.
Follow current Sailing training and quest unlocks; the old Nooblet route does not include this skill.

nodes.name: Starter supplies
why: Paruošk maistą, basic tools ir kelionės GP. Kiekį rinkis pagal kitą quest; UIM laikyk tik reikalingus daiktus.
Prepare food, basic tools and travel GP. Size supplies for the next quest; UIM should carry only needed items.

nodes.name: Thieving → 5
why: Kelti tik iki 5 pradiniam GP ir cake stall keliui. Jei lygis jau pasiektas, šis žingsnis praleidžiamas.
Train only to 5 for starter GP and the cake stall route. Skip this step when the level is already reached.

nodes.name: Chronicle
why: Įsigyk Chronicle ir teleport cards Draynor prieš Varrock questų grupę.
Obtain a Chronicle and teleport cards in Draynor before the Varrock quest batch.

nodes.name: Natural history quiz
why: Atlik museum quiz prieš rankinį Hunter ir Slayer kėlimą.
Complete the museum quiz before manually training early Hunter and Slayer.

nodes.name: Ardougne cloak 1
why: Užbaik visus Ardougne easy diary tasks ir atsiimk cloak; Biohazard vienas diary neužbaigia.
Complete every Ardougne easy diary task and claim the cloak; Biohazard alone does not complete the diary.

nodes.name: Fairy rings
why: Pradėk Fairytale II ir pasiek fairy rings atrakinimą. Tai atskiras žingsnis nuo viso quest užbaigimo.
Start Fairytale II and reach fairy ring access. This is separate from completing the whole quest.

nodes.name: Bird house trapping
why: Po Bone Voyage paruošk clockworks, tinkamus logs ir seeds; pradėk birdhouse ciklą.
After Bone Voyage prepare clockworks, suitable logs and seeds; begin the birdhouse loop.

nodes.name: Giant seaweed
why: Pradėk kaupti seaweed ir sand Crafting tikslams; tai resursų ciklas, ne vienkartinis level grind.
Start collecting seaweed and sand for Crafting; this is a resource loop rather than a one-off level grind.

nodes.name: Herb run
why: Naudok turimas seeds ir patches; Farming bei Herblore tiekimą pradėk prieš ilgesnį Slayer.
Use available seeds and patches; establish Farming and Herblore supplies before extended Slayer.

nodes.name: Protection prayers
why: Kelti Prayer iki 43, pagal turimus bones ir pasirinktą saugų metodą. HCIM nerekomenduojamas Wilderness kelias.
Train Prayer to 43 using available bones and an appropriate safe method. The Wilderness route is not recommended for HCIM.

nodes.name: Rogue equipment
why: Rogue outfit rinkis prieš ilgesnį pickpocket GP etapą; šis pasirinkimas nereikalauja 99 Thieving.
Obtain rogue equipment before an extended pickpocket cash phase; this does not require 99 Thieving.

nodes.name: Graceful outfit
why: Rooftop Agility ir marks of grace. Aukštas Agility neįrodo, kad outfit jau įsigytas.
Train rooftop Agility and collect marks of grace. A high Agility level does not prove outfit ownership.

nodes.name: Dragon scimitar
why: Po Monkey Madness I įsigyk melee upgrade, jeigu jo dar neturi.
After Monkey Madness I obtain the melee upgrade if you do not own it.

nodes.name: Dragon defender
why: Patikrink Warriors Guild entry, gauk tokens ir pereik defender grandinę. 60 Defence reikalingas dragon defender dėvėjimui.
Check Warriors Guild entry, obtain tokens and work through the defender chain. 60 Defence is needed to equip the dragon defender.
checks: Warriors Guild: Attack + Strength 130 OR 99 Attack / 99 Strength; tokens and defender chain

nodes.name: Barrows gloves
why: Po RFD finalo gloves dar reikia įsigyti iš Culinaromancer chest.
After the RFD finale purchase the gloves from the Culinaromancer chest.

nodes.name: Black mask
why: Patikrink Cave horror supplies ir įrangą; gauk black mask, jei jo neturi. Drop negarantuojamas per konkretų KC.
Check Cave horror supplies and equipment; obtain a black mask if missing. No specific kill count guarantees the drop.

nodes.name: Fire cape
why: Pasiruošk Fight Caves ir Jad. Fire cape yra atlygis; šis žingsnis netvirtina boss readiness iš KC.
Prepare for the Fight Caves and Jad. The fire cape is the reward; this step does not infer boss readiness from kill count.

nodes.name: The Gauntlet
why: Po Song of the Elves mokykis Gauntlet; crystal gear planą pasirink pagal kovinius stats ir turimą įrangą.
After Song of the Elves learn the Gauntlet; choose a crystal gear plan using combat stats and existing gear.

nodes.name: Trident of the seas
why: Slayer 87 atveria Kraken kelią; patikrink task ir supplies, tada ieškok upgrade.
Slayer 87 opens the Kraken route; verify the task and supplies, then pursue the upgrade.

nodes.name: PvM progression
why: Pasirink kitą raid ar boss pagal quests, gear ir supplies. Max stats ar 0 KC savaime nepatvirtina pasiruošimo.
Choose the next raid or boss using quests, gear and supplies. Max stats or zero kill count alone do not prove readiness.

nodes.name: 99 Attack
why: Quest XP, tada Slayer su tinkamu melee weapon.
Quest XP, then Slayer with a suitable melee weapon.

nodes.name: 99 Strength
why: Quest XP ir Slayer; AFK combat pasirinkimas tik pagal savo supplies.
Quest XP and Slayer; choose AFK combat using your supplies.

nodes.name: 99 Defence
why: Quest XP ir combat training pagal kitą gear requirement.
Quest XP and combat training toward the next gear requirement.

nodes.name: 99 Hitpoints
why: Combat training kartu su pasirinktu Slayer ar combat tikslu.
Combat training alongside the chosen Slayer or combat goal.

nodes.name: 99 Ranged
why: Quest XP, tada tinkamas bow/crossbow ir ammunition pagal account type.
Quest XP, then a suitable bow/crossbow and ammunition for the account type.

nodes.name: 99 Magic
why: Quest XP ir combat spells; alchemy tik su spell level, runes ir tinkamais daiktais.
Quest XP and combat spells; use alchemy only with the spell level, runes and suitable items.

nodes.name: 99 Prayer
why: Quest XP ir turimi bones; saugų metodą rinkis pagal account type.
Quest XP and available bones; select a safe method for the account type.

nodes.name: 99 Agility
why: Quest XP, tada prieinamas course; marks of grace tik rooftop kursuose.
Quest XP, then an accessible course; collect marks of grace on rooftop courses.

nodes.name: 99 Herblore
why: Druidic Ritual, quest lamps ir potions iš turimų herbs bei secondaries.
Druidic Ritual, quest lamps and potions using available herbs and secondaries.

nodes.name: 99 Thieving
why: Quest XP, prieinami stalls/pickpocket; rogue outfit prieš ilgą pickpocket etapą.
Quest XP, accessible stalls/pickpocketing; rogue equipment before extended pickpocketing.

nodes.name: 99 Crafting
why: Quest XP, tada glass/gems pagal turimus resursus; seaweed ir sand kaupk iš anksto.
Quest XP, then glass/gems using available resources; collect seaweed and sand ahead of time.

nodes.name: 99 Construction
why: Pradinis quest XP ir planks; Mahogany Homes arba POH pagal GP bei planks.
Starter quest XP and planks; Mahogany Homes or POH training depending on GP and planks.

nodes.name: 99 Fishing
why: Quest XP, maisto tiekimas arba Barbarian Fishing kaip AFK šaka.
Quest XP, food supplies or Barbarian Fishing as an AFK branch.

nodes.name: 99 Cooking
why: Quest XP, tada turimo maisto ruošimas; nereikia pirkti perteklinio kiekio.
Quest XP, then cooking available food; avoid buying excess supplies.

nodes.name: 99 Firemaking
why: Logs pagal dabartinį level; Wintertodt pasirenkama šaka nuo 50 Firemaking.
Use logs appropriate to your level; Wintertodt is an optional branch from 50 Firemaking.

nodes.name: 99 Woodcutting
why: Quest XP, tada prieinami trees su tinkamu axe; logs panaudok kitiems skillams.
Quest XP, then accessible trees with a suitable axe; reuse logs for other skills.

nodes.name: 99 Mining
why: Quest XP, ore resursai arba AFK mining; sand rinkimas gali palaikyti Crafting.
Quest XP, ore supplies or AFK mining; sand collection can support Crafting.

nodes.name: 99 Smithing
why: Quest XP, tada bars ir prieinami minigames pagal GP bei ore.
Quest XP, then bars and accessible minigames using available GP and ore.

nodes.name: 99 Fletching
why: Turimi logs ir ammunition; pirmiausia rezervuok quest bei birdhouse logs.
Available logs and ammunition; reserve quest and birdhouse logs first.

nodes.name: 99 Runecraft
why: Quest XP, tada prieinamas altar ar minigame po jo quest reikalavimų.
Quest XP, then an accessible altar or minigame after its quest requirements.

nodes.name: 99 Slayer
why: Pasirink master pagal combat ir quest prieigą; supplies bei block list tikrink atskirai.
Choose a master using combat level and quest access; check supplies and the block list separately.

nodes.name: 99 Farming
why: Quest XP, herb/tree runs ir prieinami contracts; naudok turimas seeds.
Quest XP, herb/tree runs and accessible contracts using available seeds.

nodes.name: 99 Hunter
why: Museum quiz, birdhouses po Bone Voyage; active Hunter kaip atskira šaka.
Museum quiz, birdhouses after Bone Voyage; active Hunter is a separate branch.

nodes.name: 99 Sailing
why: Sek dabartinį Sailing mokymą ir quest unlocks; senas Nooblet maršrutas šio skill neapima.
Follow current Sailing training and quest unlocks; the old Nooblet route does not include this skill.
